data.why: The repo ships only outputs/final-benchmark/ (used by the Overview and Reliability Lab tabs); the quantification/connectivity/radiomics 'real' cached outputs the full CLI pipeline would produce from the downloaded OpenNeuro ds001705 dataset are gitignored, so synthetic CSV/JSON stand-ins matching the exact schema app/app.py reads were written for subjects 000101-000103 x baseline/displaced to drive the TAC Explorer, Kinetic Quantification, and Dynamic Features/Radiomics tabs; the Connectivity tab's matrix cache is binary .npz which cannot be authored as text, so it is intentionally left absent and degrades gracefully.

goals: Read the measured pilot findings on the Overview tab: how much normalized-AUC error is introduced by truncating a dynamic PET scan to 60/45/30 minutes.

Use the Reliability Lab to pick an acquisition constraint (duration, sampling, noise, motion) and see whether a given endpoint family (model-free, intervention, connectivity, radiomics) stays within its configured reliability threshold.

In Kinetic Quantification, inspect model-free TAC features (AUC, early/late uptake, peak, slopes) per subject/ROI and find the one changed region whose late-uptake proxy diverges sharply from its known ground truth.

In the 4-D PET / TAC Explorer, compare a clean regional time-activity curve against zero-fill, linear-interpolation, and tiny-TCN reconstructions after 40% of frames are masked, and judge recovery by AUC error rather than curve smoothness.

In Dynamic Features / Radiomics, identify which per-frame texture/intensity features are most robust to acquisition degradation versus which are most sensitive, and separate true biological change from acquisition-driven variation.
Understand why SRTM BPnd is explicitly withheld rather than estimated, as a case study in refusing to report an unsupported quantitative claim.

review.summary: The goal and phases match the README's question (how far dynamic PET can be degraded, and whether temporal recovery restores the conclusions) at a sensible depth, and every screen I opened supports its node. Before filing, it needs a stub for the unreachable connectivity stage and a general wording for the planted-outlier task, the biology table's condition claim must be fixed (the code ignores condition there), and the synthetic seed numbers must be flagged so they aren't read as study findings.
